spec.description: RWA BasisQuoter source risk versus IBKR hedge positions, residual exposure, IB PnL, execution shortfall, latency, fills, and pipeline health.

panels.description: All values should be 1. Missing data is also unhealthy: the process is not writing.

targets.query: SELECT last("healthy") FROM "hedger_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/
SELECT last("connected") FROM "hedger_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/
SELECT last("up") FROM "rwa_poller_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/
SELECT last("poller_up") FROM "ib_poller_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "host" =~ /^tky-c-ibgw-01.*$/

panels.title: Pipeline health (last 2m)

panels.description: Perfectly hedged is zero. No data means one side is absent/stale; inspect the position chart.

targets.query: SELECT last("risk_qty") AS "source_qty" FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol"
SELECT last("qty") AS "ib_qty" FROM "ib_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Current net position (source + IB)

panels.description: (source qty + IB qty) × current IB midpoint. Requires fresh IB market data.

targets.query: SELECT last("risk_qty") AS "source_qty" FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol"
SELECT last("qty") AS "ib_qty" FROM "ib_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"
SELECT last("mid") AS "mid" FROM "ib_price" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Current residual exposure

panels.description: abs(IB quantity / source quantity). 100% is fully hedged; it ignores price basis.

targets.query: SELECT last("risk_qty") AS "source_qty" FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol"
SELECT last("qty") AS "ib_qty" FROM "ib_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Current hedge ratio

panels.description: The two lines should be equal and opposite. Source uses the per-symbol perp_total aggregate.

targets.query: SELECT last("risk_qty") FROM "rwa_position" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

SELECT last("qty") FROM "ib_position" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

panels.title: Source risk versus IB hedge quantity

panels.description: (source + IB) × IB midpoint. Short gaps can appear when the independent pollers land in different buckets.

targets.query: SELECT last("risk_qty") FROM "rwa_position" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

SELECT last("qty") FROM "ib_position" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)
SELECT last("mid") FROM "ib_price" WHERE $timeFilter AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

panels.title: Residual exposure through time

panels.description: IBKR reqPnLSingle daily PnL. This is the reliable hedge-leg PnL measure.

targets.query: SELECT last("daily_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: IB daily PnL

panels.description: Current IBKR unrealized PnL by selected symbol.

targets.query: SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: IB unrealized PnL

panels.description: Current IBKR realized PnL by selected symbol. IB may re-base this across sessions.

targets.query: SELECT last("realized_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: IB realized PnL

panels.description: Latest source position notional using the position poller's fill-derived mark. This is exposure, not earnings.

targets.query: SELECT last("notional") FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 2m AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Source marked exposure (not PnL)

options.content: **IB PnL is authoritative from IBKR. Source/quoter PnL is not currently published to `rwa_strategies`.** `rwa_position.notional` is marked exposure, not PnL, and its fill-derived mark can be stale. A reliable combined earnings panel needs a dedicated source PnL measurement with common start-of-period inventory, marks, and fees.

panels.description: IBKR-computed daily PnL. Reconnect/session re-bases may appear as discontinuities.

targets.query: SELECT last("daily_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

panels.title: IB daily PnL history

panels.description: IBKR daily, realized, and unrealized PnL. Reconnects can re-base these series.

targets.query: SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

SELECT last("realized_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

panels.title: IB PnL components

panels.description: Total arrival-mid shortfall over the selected range. Positive is execution cost; negative is improvement.

targets.query: SELECT sum("shortfall_usd") FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Implementation shortfall

panels.description: Unweighted mean across hedge executions. Positive is worse than decision midpoint.

targets.query: SELECT mean("shortfall_bps") FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Mean shortfall

panels.description: 95th percentile adverse implementation shortfall by symbol.

targets.query: SELECT percentile("shortfall_bps", 95) FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: P95 shortfall

panels.description: Median milliseconds from accepted hedge decision to each IB execution.

targets.query: SELECT median("decision_to_fill_ms") FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Median decision→fill

panels.description: Arrival-mid shortfall by symbol and execution algo. Positive values are adverse.

targets.query: SELECT mean("shortfall_bps") FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol", "algo" fill(null)

panels.title: Implementation shortfall through time

panels.description: Median and P95 decision-to-fill latency. This is not source-trade-to-hedge latency.

targets.query: SELECT median("decision_to_fill_ms") FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(null)

SELECT percentile("decision_to_fill_ms", 95) FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(null)

panels.title: Decision-to-fill latency

panels.description: Raw fill-level arrival shortfall. Limited to 250 rows to keep the browser responsive.

targets.query: SELECT "symbol", "side", "algo", "order_id", "perm_id", "fill_qty", "fill_price", "arrival_mid", "shortfall_bps", "shortfall_usd", "decision_to_fill_ms" FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" = 'Fill' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 250

panels.title: Recent hedge executions

panels.description: Notional already includes the contract multiplier. Never divide it by raw quantity to infer price.

targets.query: SELECT sum("notional") FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(0)

SELECT sum("notional") FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(0)

panels.title: Fill notional by leg

panels.description: Order/fill/cancel/error counts. Rising cancels or validation errors indicate churn or execution problems.

targets.query: SELECT count("order_id") FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" =~ /^${env:regex}$/ AND "account" =~ /^${account:regex}$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/ AND "event" =~ /Fill|Cancelled|ValidationError|PendingSubmit/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol", "event" fill(0)

panels.title: Hedger lifecycle events

options.content: The shortfall panels benchmark each IB fill against the **IB midpoint when the hedge order was accepted**. They do not measure the complete path from the original RWA perp fill to the final IB fill. That end-to-end metric requires source-event attribution and an order/fill join that InfluxQL/Grafana cannot perform reliably at query time. Materialize an episode-level measurement before adding that metric here. The shortfall panels also require the analytics logger version that writes `arrival_mid`, `shortfall_usd`, `shortfall_bps`, and `decision_to_fill_ms`; otherwise they show no data.
